zh.title: 隐私政策
zh.summary: 漫画留在本机。我们不收集、不上传、不出售任何个人信息。
sections: 适用范围与联系
本政策适用于微光漫卷（英文名 LumiComic）iOS 应用、安卓应用及本网站，iOS 部分与 App 内「设置 → 隐私政策」一致，安卓版的差异见「安卓版」一节。微光漫卷是一款只读取你自己文件的离线图片阅读器。开发者为 liaozhiliang，联系邮箱为 support@surveykit.cc。
我们不收集的信息
App 没有账号与登录，不内置广告、统计分析或任何第三方 SDK，也不进行跟踪。
App 本身不发送任何网络请求。你的漫画、书架、阅读进度和设置都不会离开这台设备。
保存在你设备上的数据
导入的漫画：默认在 App 内保存一份副本，原文件不会被修改；副本不包含在 iCloud 或电脑备份中。
原位阅读：只保存系统提供的文件访问授权，不复制原件。
书架信息：系列与分组、阅读进度、书签、阅读设置和导入记录，保存在 App 的本地数据库中。
页面缓存：为加快翻页生成的缩小图片，存放在系统缓存目录，空间不足时可能被系统清理。
这些数据只供 App 在本机使用。你可以在 App 中删除漫画；删除 App 会清除以上全部数据。
使用的系统功能
文件访问：App 只能读取你在系统文件选择器中主动选择的文件。
面容 ID、触控 ID 或设备密码（应用锁）：验证由 iOS 完成，App 只得到“是否通过”的结果，无法获取你的生物特征信息。
App 内购买：购买与恢复购买由 Apple 通过 App Store 处理。App 只从系统读取是否已解锁 Pro，开发者不会获得你的支付信息或 Apple 账户信息。
崩溃报告：如果你在 iOS“设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 分析与改进”中选择与 App 开发者共享，Apple 可能向开发者提供不含个人身份信息的崩溃报告。是否共享由你决定。
你主动联系我们
通过邮件联系时，你提供的邮箱地址、问题描述、截图或文件，仅用于回复和解决问题，不用于营销，问题解决后不再需要时删除。请不要发送有版权的漫画文件或与问题无关的个人信息；排查问题通常只需要文件名的截图。
支持网站
本网站为静态页面，没有统计脚本、Cookie、表单或第三方字体。托管服务商 Cloudflare 可能为安全和运维需要处理访问日志，例如 IP 地址和浏览器信息。
安卓版
安卓版同样没有账号、广告、统计或跟踪工具，并且不申请网络权限、不发送网络请求。
App 只读取你在系统文件选择器中主动选择的文件，在 App 私有目录保存一份副本，不申请访问全部文件的权限，不扫描你的设备。如果你选择云盘文件，该文件提供方可能需要自行下载；App 本身不会联网。
书架信息与页面缓存的处理与上文相同。安卓版关闭了系统备份；清除 App 数据或卸载 App 会清除本地书架和导入副本，请自行保留原文件。
当前安卓版未接入购买、应用锁或生物识别服务。
未成年人
App 不收集任何人的个人信息，包括未满 14 周岁的未成年人。
政策更新与联系方式
本政策如有变更，会随 App 更新发布，并更新上方的生效日期。
如有疑问，请发邮件到 support@surveykit.cc，或通过 App Store 产品页中的“App 支持”链接联系我们。

en.title: Privacy Policy
en.summary: Your comics stay on your device. We do not collect, upload or sell any personal information.
sections: Scope and contact

This policy covers the LumiComic (微光漫卷) iOS app, the Android app and this website. The iOS parts match Settings → Privacy Policy in the app; see “Android app” for how the Android version differs. LumiComic is an offline image reader that only opens your own files. The developer is liaozhiliang; contact support@surveykit.cc.
What we do not collect
There are no accounts or sign-in. The app contains no ads, analytics or third-party SDKs, and it does not track you.
The app itself makes no network requests. Your comics, library, reading progress and settings never leave this device.
Data stored on your device
Imported comics: by default the app keeps a copy inside the app and never modifies the original file. Copies are excluded from iCloud and computer backups.
Read in place: only the file access permission provided by the system is stored; the original is not copied.
Library information: series and groups, reading progress, bookmarks, reader settings and import history are kept in the app’s local database.
Page cache: downsized images generated for faster page turns are kept in the system cache folder and may be cleared by the system when space is low.
This data is used only by the app on this device. You can delete comics in the app; deleting the app removes all of the data above.
System features
File access: the app can only read files you choose in the system file picker.
Face ID, Touch ID or device passcode (app lock): verification is handled by iOS. The app only learns whether it succeeded and cannot access your biometric data.

In-app purchase: purchases and restores are handled by Apple through the App Store. The app only reads from the system whether Pro is unlocked; the developer never receives your payment details or Apple Account information.

Crash reports: if you choose to share with app developers in iOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Analytics & Improvements, Apple may provide the developer with crash reports that do not identify you. Sharing is up to you.
When you contact us

If you email us, your email address, description, screenshots or files are used only to reply and resolve your issue, never for marketing, and are deleted once no longer needed. Please do not send copyrighted comic files or personal details unrelated to the issue; a screenshot of the file names is usually enough.
Support website

This website is static, with no analytics scripts, cookies, forms or third-party fonts. Our hosting provider, Cloudflare, may process access logs such as IP addresses and browser details for security and operations.
Android app
The Android app likewise has no accounts, ads, analytics or tracking tools, and it does not request internet permission or send network requests.

It reads only files you select in the system file picker and saves a copy in its private directory. It does not request all-files access or scan your device. If you select a cloud file, its document provider may need to download it; the app itself does not connect to the internet.

Library information and the page cache are handled as described above. Android system backup is disabled; clearing app data or uninstalling removes the local library and imported copies, so keep your original files.
The current Android app does not include purchases, app locking or biometric authentication.
Children
The app does not collect personal information from anyone, including children.
Changes and contact
If this policy changes, the update will ship with an app update and the effective date above will change.
If you have questions, email support@surveykit.cc or use the “App Support” link on the App Store product page.

zh.title: 用户协议
zh.summary: 微光漫卷只读取你自己的文件。核心功能永久免费，Pro 一次买断。
sections: 应用与协议
微光漫卷（LumiComic）由开发者 liaozhiliang 提供和维护，联系邮箱为 support@surveykit.cc。下载或使用应用即表示你同意本协议。通过 App Store 获取应用时，相应商店与软件许可条款仍适用，包括未另行提供自定义许可时的 Apple 标准最终用户许可协议。
应用的作用
微光漫卷是本地文件阅读工具。它不提供、不出售、不推荐任何漫画内容，不提供资源搜索、书源或插件，也不会把你的文件上传到任何地方。
你的内容与版权
请只导入你有权使用的文件。你对导入内容的合法性负责。应用不处理数字版权管理（DRM）保护的文件，也不提供任何绕过保护的方法；遇到加密或受保护的文件时会说明无法打开。
免费功能与 Pro
导入与阅读所有支持的格式、单页/双页/条漫阅读模式、系列整理、分组、进度与书签永久免费，不做计时试用。公开上架时免费的功能，以后不会改为付费，也不会加次数限制。微光 Pro 为一次买断，不是订阅，解锁自动裁白边、应用锁与隐藏系列、原位阅读、批量整理、自动翻页和画面滤镜；购买后，后续加入 Pro 的功能免费获得。Pro 支持家人共享和恢复购买；退款由 Apple 按其规则处理。
失去 Pro 时
如果退款或在未购买的设备上使用，已有的书架、进度、书签和设置仍可正常使用，只停用 Pro 的新增操作。已开启的应用锁仍可以解锁和关闭，只是不能新加锁。
文件与数据
应用只读不写你的原文件。默认导入时会在应用内保存一份副本；使用 Pro 的原位阅读时，只保存系统提供的文件访问授权。从书架删除漫画会清除应用内副本、阅读位置和书签，不影响原文件。数据只保存在本机，1.0 不提供备份，开发者也无法替你找回，请保留原文件。
格式与兼容
1.0 支持 ZIP、CBZ、PDF 和以图片为主的漫画 EPUB，暂不支持 RAR/CBR 和直接导入图片文件夹。加密或需要密码的文件、受 DRM 保护的文件和以文字为主的 EPUB 无法导入，损坏的页面可能无法完整显示。实际支持以所装版本为准。
免责与责任限制
应用按现状提供。在法律允许的范围内，开发者不保证应用适合所有用途或没有错误，也不对数据丢失、设备问题或使用导入内容引起的后果承担超出法律要求的责任。本条不影响你依法享有的权利。
变更与联系
我们可能更新本协议，并在本页修改日期；重大变更会在应用更新说明中提示。继续使用即表示接受更新后的协议。如有问题，请联系 support@surveykit.cc。

en.title: Terms of Use
en.summary: LumiComic only reads your own files. Core features are free forever; Pro is a one-time purchase.
sections: The app and these terms

LumiComic (微光漫卷) is provided and maintained by developer liaozhiliang. Contact support@surveykit.cc. By downloading or using the app you agree to these terms. Applicable App Store and software licence terms also apply, including Apple’s Standard End User Licence Agreement when no custom licence is supplied.
What the app does
LumiComic is a local file reader. It does not provide, sell or recommend any comic content, offers no content search, sources or plug-ins, and never uploads your files anywhere.
Your content and copyright

Import only files you have the right to use. You are responsible for the content you import. The app does not handle files protected by digital rights management (DRM) and offers no way around such protection; it tells you when a file is encrypted or protected and cannot be opened.
Free features and Pro

Importing and reading every supported format, Single, Spread and Scroll reading modes, series organisation, groups, reading positions and bookmarks are free forever, with no timed trial. Features that are free at public launch will never become paid or limited. LumiComic Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. It unlocks auto-crop margins, App Lock and hidden series, Read in place, batch organising, auto page turning and image filters; Pro features added later are included at no extra cost. Pro supports Family Sharing and Restore Purchases; refunds are handled by Apple under its rules.
If you lose Pro

After a refund, or on a device without the purchase, your library, reading positions, bookmarks and settings keep working; only new Pro actions stop. An existing App Lock can still be unlocked and turned off, but new locks cannot be added.
Files and data

The app never writes to your original files. By default it keeps a copy inside the app when you import; with Pro's Read in place it stores only the file access permission provided by the system. Deleting a comic from the library removes the in-app copy, reading position and bookmarks, never the original. Data stays only on your device; version 1.0 has no backup and the developer cannot recover it for you, so please keep your originals.
Formats and compatibility

Version 1.0 supports ZIP, CBZ, PDF and image-based comic EPUB; RAR/CBR and importing image folders directly are not supported yet. Encrypted or password-protected files, DRM-protected files and mostly-text EPUBs cannot be imported, and damaged pages may not display fully. Actual support depends on your installed version.
Disclaimer and limitation of liability

The app is provided as is. To the extent permitted by law, the developer does not guarantee that it suits every purpose or is free of errors, and is not liable beyond what the law requires for data loss, device problems or consequences of using imported content. Nothing here limits your statutory rights.
Changes and contact

We may update these terms and will change the date on this page; significant changes will be noted in the app's release notes. Continuing to use the app means you accept the updated terms. Questions: support@surveykit.cc.

zh.title: 技术支持
zh.summary: 导入、排序、阅读模式、乱码、空间与购买的常见问题。
sections: 怎么导入漫画？

在书架点「导入漫画」，从系统「文件」中选择一个或多个文件。1.0 支持 ZIP、CBZ、PDF 和以图片为主的漫画 EPUB。导入时会在应用内复制一份，原文件不会被修改；重复的文件会自动跳过。购买 Pro 后可以改用「原位阅读」，直接读取「文件」中的原件而不复制。暂不支持 RAR/CBR、直接导入图片文件夹，以及从其他 App 分享或「用…打开」导入；可以先把图片打包成 ZIP 或 CBZ 再导入。
系列或卷、话的顺序不对
应用会按文件名识别系列、卷与话，并按自然顺序排好，例如「第 12 话」「Vol.3」「Ch.12」。如果顺序仍然不对，请把文件名列表的截图发给我们，不需要发送漫画本身。
阅读模式、方向与缩放
阅读时轻点画面中间呼出工具栏，在阅读设置里可以选择单页、双页或条漫模式，以及从左向右或从右向左翻页；双页模式下可以设置封面单独显示或与第二页拼合。漫画包里带有日漫方向标记时，会自动设为从右向左。双击或双指捏合可以放大，目录与缩略图可以快速跳页。
文件名显示成乱码
应用会自动识别 GBK、Big5 和 Shift_JIS 编码的压缩包文件名。如果仍然乱码，请告诉我们压缩包是用什么工具、在什么系统上打包的，并附一张乱码截图。
文件打不开
暂不支持加密或需要密码的压缩包和 PDF，也不支持受 DRM 保护的文件；以文字为主的 EPUB 也无法导入。遇到这些情况时，应用会给出提示。如果其他文件整本打不开，请告诉我们文件格式和大小。
占用空间太大
导入的漫画会在应用内保存一份副本。从书架删除漫画会同时清除应用内副本、阅读位置和书签，原文件不受影响。翻页用的缩小图片存放在系统缓存目录，空间不足时系统可能自动清理。使用 Pro 的原位阅读时不复制原件。
换手机或重装后
1.0 暂不提供备份与恢复。书架、阅读进度和书签只保存在本机，删除 App 会一并清除；换设备或重装后，需要重新导入漫画。请保留好原文件。
Pro、恢复购买与退款
微光 Pro 是一次买断，不是订阅，解锁自动裁白边、应用锁与隐藏系列、原位阅读、批量整理、自动翻页和画面滤镜。入口在「设置 → 微光 Pro」。换设备或重装后，在同一页点「恢复购买」即可。Pro 支持家人共享。退款请通过 Apple 的退款页面申请，开发者无法直接处理付款。
联系我们
请发邮件到 support@surveykit.cc，写明设备型号、iOS 版本、应用版本和问题经过，最好附上截图。请不要附带有版权的漫画文件。我们会尽快回复。

en.title: Support
en.summary: Answers about importing, ordering, reading modes, garbled names, storage and purchases.
sections: How do I import comics?

Tap Import comics in the library and pick one or more files in Files. Version 1.0 supports ZIP, CBZ, PDF and image-based comic EPUB. Importing keeps a copy inside the app and never changes your original files; duplicates are skipped automatically. With Pro you can use Read in place to open originals in Files without copying them. RAR/CBR, importing image folders directly, and importing via Share or Open in from other apps are not supported yet; you can zip the images into a ZIP or CBZ first.
Series, volumes or chapters are in the wrong order

The app reads series, volumes and chapters from file names and sorts them in natural order, for example Vol.3 or Ch.12. If the order is still wrong, send us a screenshot of the file names; there is no need to send the comics.
Reading modes, direction and zoom

Tap the middle of the page to show the controls. In Reader settings you can choose Single, Spread or Scroll mode, and left-to-right or right-to-left; in spreads you can show the cover alone or pair it with page 2. When a comic file carries a manga direction flag, the book opens right-to-left automatically. Double-tap or pinch to zoom, and use Contents and thumbnails to jump between pages.
File names look garbled
The app detects archive file names encoded in GBK, Big5 and Shift_JIS. If names still look garbled, tell us which tool and system created the archive and include a screenshot.
A file will not open

Encrypted or password-protected archives and PDFs, DRM-protected files and mostly-text EPUBs are not supported, and the app tells you when it meets one. If another file will not open at all, tell us its format and size.
The app takes up too much space

Imported comics are kept as a copy inside the app. Deleting a comic from the library removes the in-app copy, reading position and bookmarks, never your original file. Downsized page images live in the system cache and may be cleared by the system when space is low. Pro's Read in place does not copy originals.
New device or reinstalling

Version 1.0 does not offer backup or restore. Your library, reading positions and bookmarks are stored only on this device and are removed when you delete the app; on a new device or after reinstalling, import your comics again. Please keep your original files.
Pro, Restore Purchases and refunds

LumiComic Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. It unlocks auto-crop margins, App Lock and hidden series, Read in place, batch organising, auto page turning and image filters. Find it in Settings → LumiComic Pro; on a new device or after reinstalling, tap Restore purchase there. Pro supports Family Sharing. To request a refund, use Apple's refund page; the developer cannot process payments directly.
Contact us

Email support@surveykit.cc with your device model, iOS version, app version and what happened, ideally with a screenshot. Please do not attach copyrighted comic files. We will reply as soon as we can.
